title: delphinium nuttallii subsp. ochroleucum
intro: Delphinium nuttallii subsp. ochroleucum, commonly known as the pale lespedeza or pale delphinium, is a flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Delphinium nuttallii subsp. ochroleucum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
